title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act), Article 14
book_use: Chapter 12: effective human oversight for covered high-risk AI systems; overseers need usable information and authority to understand limitations, guard against automation bias, interpret outputs, override or reverse outputs, and interrupt systems where necessary. Use as a design-requirement boundary, not proof that human review is empirically effective.

author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
book_use: Chapter 12: human roles and responsibilities in AI decision-making and oversight should be clearly defined; use with NIST human-AI interaction guidance to support the distinction between nominal human presence and specified oversight authority. Voluntary guidance, not a legal mandate.

author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Appendix C: AI Risk Management and Human-AI Interaction
book_use: Chapter 12: human-AI configurations range from fully autonomous to fully manual; some systems may not require human oversight, while bias and opacity can limit oversight quality. Use as counterevidence against a universal 'human in the loop' prescription.
